about: S3.8 governance checks (DOC-07) — the TUNING set: fictional companies run against the 'Corporate governance review' preset. Expectations are the discrepancies a company-secretarial lawyer would raise (kind and the start of the title); the control company is consistent. G4–G6 were the first held-out set.

documents.text:
ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION of Tidewater Holdings Ltd (fictional)

1. Share capital
1.1 The share capital of the company consists of ordinary shares and A preference shares.

2. Directors
2.1 The number of directors shall not be less than two.
2.2 The quorum for board meetings is two directors.
2.3 Not less than seven (7) days' notice shall be given of every board meeting.
